findings.conclusion: Conflicting waiting period terms: Base policy Section 4.4 requires 48 months (doc-base-policy-silver, p. 16), whereas Endorsement END-2026-04 reduces this to 24 months (doc-endorsement-2026-v1, p. 1). However, the endorsement's stated effective date is 01-Nov-2026, post-dating planned admission on 28-Oct-2026.

evidence.quote: Section 4.4: Joint replacement surgeries shall be subject to a waiting period of forty-eight (48) consecutive months of continuous coverage.
Endorsement No. END-2026-04: Effective from 01-Nov-2026, Section 4.4 waiting period is amended to twenty-four (24) months.

limitations: Cannot automatically apply newer endorsement because effective date succeeds planned admission date.
Requires insurer confirmation whether endorsement grace applies.
findings.next_action: Contact insurer helpline or desk to clarify if 24-month endorsement rule applies to an admission 4 days before endorsement effective date.

evidence.quote: Endorsement No. END-2026-04: Effective from 01-Nov-2026, Section 4.4 waiting period is amended to twenty-four (24) months.

document_applicability.reason: Endorsement END-2026-04 amends joint replacement waiting periods to 24 months, but effective date is 01-Nov-2026, which is after planned admission date 28-Oct-2026. Precedence and applicability for late October admission are uncertain.

unresolved_questions: Does Endorsement END-2026-04 apply to an admission on 2026-10-28 when its stated effective date is 2026-11-01?
stop_details: Contradictory waiting period terms between base policy and post-dated endorsement.
